sloka: मम्गLआनि महाबाहो दिशन्तु शुभवङ्गLआः ।इति पुत्रस्य शेषाश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी ॥२-२५-३७॥
transliteration: mamgaLāni mahābāho diśantu śubhavaṅgaLāḥ ।iti putrasya śeṣāśca kṛtvā śirasi bhāminī ॥2-25-37॥

translations.english: The largeeyed Kausalya placed the remains of the offerings on his (Rama's) head and applied sandal cream to his body. She tied an auspicious medicinal herb known as Vishalyakarani to his arm for attainment of his objectives, repeatedly muttering prayers.
